name: Valuecase App
description: Valuecase MCP connects Claude to your Valuecase workspace, letting you create, manage, and monitor digital sales rooms and onboarding spaces directly from the conversation. Spin up personalised spaces from templates, set custom properties, and filter your Spaces – all without switching tools. Claude gets full context on your spaces, so you can review engagement, check progress, and keep customer-facing workflows moving from one place.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Valuecase App to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Valuecase App to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.valuecase.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Valuecase App MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Valuecase App lists 35 MCP tools, including add_or_edit_content_items, add_space_stakeholder, archive_space, create_block, create_page, create_space, create_space_comment, delete_content_items, edit_content_item, get_block, get_block_types, and get_content_editing_guide.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Valuecase App?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Valuecase App in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Valuecase App MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Valuecase App requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Valuecase App is developed by Valuecase. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
